_about: Malformed-LLM-JSON -> clean-JSON behaviour of the Flowgenix repair layer that runs on every extraction response BEFORE field scoring: backend/utils/llmJsonParser.js (parseLlmJsonResponse) -> backend/utils/jsonFixer.js (validateAndFixJSON -> fixMalformedJSON). Cases marked repairable:true were VERIFIED by running the real module at commit 704e91bf0742c226db5ba3c85a5521b109dc2b21; 'expected' is the exact parsed object it produced. Cases marked repairable:false FAIL repair -> Flowgenix error INVALID_JSON_FORMAT -> upload marked failed (see ../error_contract.md). Use the repairable set as golden pairs for a JSON-repair unit; use the non-repairable set as 'a model that emits this breaks the pipeline'.
_sources: backend/tests/llmJsonParser.test.js (the 2 pairs + 1 negative pinned by Flowgenix's own suite)
backend/utils/jsonFixer.js fixMalformedJSON steps 1-7 (remaining cases, each executed against the real function)

cases.name: trailing-comma-in-array-NOT-REPAIRED
cases.note: Verified: fixMalformedJSON does NOT recover a trailing comma inside an array here -> parseLlmJsonResponse success:false -> INVALID_JSON_FORMAT. A model that emits trailing commas in arrays will fail uploads.

cases.name: unclosed-array-NOT-REPAIRED
cases.note: Verified: truncated JSON (e.g. from finish_reason 'length') is NOT closed by fixIncompleteArrays in this shape -> INVALID_JSON_FORMAT. This is the concrete failure mode behind params.json maxOutputTokens_detail.

cases.name: not-json-NOT-REPAIRED
cases.note: parseStatus FAIL, failureMessage = 'Extraction failed: invalid JSON returned by LLM'.

cases.name: empty-string-NOT-REPAIRED
cases.note: Empty/whitespace completion -> 'Unexpected end of JSON input' -> INVALID_JSON_FORMAT. (A literal null/undefined completion yields message 'Empty LLM response' via llmJsonParser.js:7-19.)
